mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_t WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrderCount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM order_t o INNER JOIN payment_info pay ON pay.order_no = o.order_no AND pay.pay_status = 1 WHERE DATE(pay.pay_time) = CURDATE()), 0.00) AS todayPaymentAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_t WHERE status = 0) AS pendingPaymentOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_refund WHERE refund_status = 0) AS pendingRefundCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_t) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_t WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayNewUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_spu WHERE status = 1) AS onSaleProductCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.sku_id = s.id WHERE COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) <= COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10)) AS warningStockSkuCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0.00) AS amount FROM order_t o INNER JOIN payment_info pay ON pay.order_no = o.order_no AND pay.pay_status = 1 WHERE pay.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND pay.pay_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status, pay.pay_time AS payTime, o.create_time AS createTime FROM order_t o LEFT JOIN user_t u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN payment_info pay ON pay.order_no = o.order_no AND pay.pay_status = 1 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS skuId, p.seller_id AS sellerId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.name AS skuName, p.name AS productName, COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) AS availableStock, COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10) AS safetyStock FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.sku_id = s.id WHERE COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) <= COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10) ORDER BY availableStock ASC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
